title: High availability of a managed service: what the provider actually promises

videos.script: A managed database offers everything this course built by hand as a setting: backups, a standby, failover. {{offer}} It does not take the rows off your hands. A wrong delete is still yours. {{rows}} The agreement promises a percentage. Turned into time, ninety-nine point nine five is twenty-one minutes a month, and less once it is one link in a chain. {{number}} When the provider misses it, it pays back part of the bill. Not the orders you did not take. {{credit}} The failover is somebody else's, and your application still has to reconnect. {{failover}} And the backups live in the same account as the database. The one that has to survive must live somewhere else. {{backups}}
